genius_advantages.point: Toast's own research finds 48% of diners prioritize being remembered over points (22%) — i.e., points-based loyalty is losing appeal

competitor_advantages.point: Pilot: restaurants with Marketing Success Managers averaged +8% sales vs. similar Toast restaurants
Toast's data: loyalty members return ~2x the rate of new guests; 86% of email orders come from returning guests
IQ Grow "on track to become the fastest product to reach $10 million in ARR" (Aman Narang, CEO)

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Toast Loyalty is a Toast product module, not an independent competitor entity.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Toast Loyalty is a Toast product module, not an independent competitor entity.
